lines.zh: 我四条腿还不协调，走起来歪。
lines.en: Four legs, still uncoordinated. I walk crooked.
I follow behind, afraid of losing you.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌很小，踩不稳碎石。
lines.en: My feet are small; rubble trips me.
I walk close to your boots.
Every so often I look up at you.
My tail is still short.
I trip, then catch up again.
My wings wobble as I walk.
I have not learned to fold my wings.

lines.zh: 我在你左右来回换位置。
lines.en: I switch sides as we walk.

lines.zh: 我一步一步踩你的脚印。
lines.en: I step into your footprints.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的鞋，一步不落。
lines.en: I follow your boots, never falling behind.
My tail swings when I trot.

lines.zh: 我蹲在你脚边，很小一团。
lines.en: I squat at your feet, a small bundle.
I look up, waiting for you to look down.
My scales are still soft.

lines.zh: 我打了个喷嚏，喷出一点火星。
lines.en: I sneeze and a few sparks fly.
I chew my own tail for fun.
I lean against your leg for warmth.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己会长多大。
lines.en: I do not know how large I will grow.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有声音，抬头。
lines.en: I hear something far off and look up.
I rest my head on your boot.
I am sleepy, but do not want to sleep.
I am learning how to make sounds.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，没飞起来。
lines.en: I flap my wings. No lift.
I sit down. I am short.

lines.zh: 你的手一低，我就蹭过去。
lines.en: When your hand drops, I nuzzle it.
You are really very tall.

lines.zh: 我要抬头才能看见你的脸。
lines.en: I have to look up to see your face.
Will you keep me with you?
I cannot go fast. Slow down a little.
My belly is a little empty.
Crouch down a bit, please.

lines.zh: 我认得你的手，指环还戴着。
lines.en: I know your hand; the ring is still on it.
I have stared at that ring a long time.
Will I fly when I am grown?
Do not put me back in the egg.
Then I will walk with you.
I am tired. I cannot walk more.
Carry me a stretch.
I promise not to run off.
Do not leave me behind.
I am safest at your feet.
My cry comes out thin and sharp.
A pale mark where a scale came off.
I press against your boot.
It hurts, but I do not cry.
All four paws slip.
I wheeze like a little bellows.
Please do not go away.
My legs shake, but they hold.
Meat! That is meat!
Give it. Give it now.
You should eat some too.
Even hot, it goes down.
Do not pull your hand away so fast.

lines.zh: 我闻到你手指上的味道。
lines.en: I smell it on your fingers.

lines.zh: 我咬到你的手了，对不起。
lines.en: I bit your hand. Sorry.
I will take the next piece myself.
I'm young, and my scales are bronze.
I get up and keep following.
One touch of your leg and I roll.

lines.zh: 我撞在石头上，眼冒火星。
lines.en: I hit a stone and see sparks.

lines.zh: 我往你脚背上踩了一下。
lines.en: I stepped on your foot.
My horns are small; I cannot help it.

lines.zh: 我这声叫很小，像从喉咙里漏气。
lines.en: My cry is small, like air escaping my throat.
You step back and I follow.
I am still very small.
That is a long way off.
I only want to follow you.
My kind are over at the ruins.
I do not understand any of that.
My horns have not grown in yet.
Will growing take long?
My belly is very empty.
I will sleep a while.
I cannot lift this.
I hold it with both forepaws.
Carry it for me.
This one is shiny.
I hide it in your pack.
This thing is mine.
I dropped it. Pick it up for me.

lines.zh: 我用两只前爪抱着，走不动。
lines.en: I hold it in both foreclaws and cannot walk.
There is something over there!
A little bronze dragon, not yet flying.
I cried out. Did you hear?

lines.zh: 我翅膀张开了，可我不敢。
lines.en: My wings are open, but I dare not.
My throat feels warm.
Stand in front of me.
I am not moving.
It is staring at us.
I run at three.
First I take a deep breath.
That is my count of two.
We are at count three.
I have counted to three.
I am afraid to blink.
I am behind you and can see it.
When it moves, I tremble.
You raised the ring.
I have the order.
I will stand beside you.
My legs are shaking.
It has come around this side.
I back to the wall.
You are still here. I am not afraid.
Half a step forward.
It stopped. Now I dare not move.
I am counting to myself.
I look up at your hand.
I shift half a step behind you.
I spray a few sparks.

lines.zh: 我这一口，连毛都咬不掉。
lines.en: This bite will not even take hair.

lines.zh: 我抓了一下，爪子还很软。
lines.en: I rake, but my claws are soft.
One swing and I fly.
I get up and return to your side.
I still want to bite it.
That was all my strength.
I cannot beat it at all.
You had better go instead.
I will shout for you.
I have fallen back.
It is not hurt at all.
Then I will try once more.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里滚出来，壳还在头上。
lines.en: I roll out of the egg, shell still on my head.

lines.zh: 我第一次看见光，很刺眼。
lines.en: My first sight of light. It stings.
My legs will not straighten.
A ring sways in front of my eyes.
I try crawling toward you.
My voice is very small.
I fell the moment I stood.
You reach out and I climb on.
This is so much bigger than the egg.
My wings are stuck to my back.
I bit one of your fingers.
Do not move. I am a little scared.
My belly is already empty.
I curl up in your palm.
I burp and sparks come out.
When you laugh, I feel safe.
I am going to follow you always.
Fire touches me and I shriek.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，翻了好几个滚。
lines.en: I fall and roll over and over.

lines.zh: 水一下就没过我，我乱扑腾。
lines.en: Water covers me and I flail.
The blast throws me to your feet.
The arrow scraped past my wing.
I go numb all over and cannot move.
I have no strength. I cannot walk.
